name: pdfcpu-verified-attachment-integrity-lifecycle
instr:
Give pdfcpu users an end-to-end attachment integrity lifecycle based on SHA-256 of the exact uncompressed embedded bytes. Integrity must remain observable and enforceable from the model through public APIs, commands, and the executable without breaking legacy PDFs or established attachment workflows. Users must be able to verify, policy-gate extraction, and safely repair missing integrity metadata.

Checksum integrity remains stable across attachment creation, serialization, rereading, and metadata-only inspection for ordinary and portfolio attachments, including when a legacy payload cannot be decoded. Verification resolves canonical keys, filenames, and descriptions to canonical EmbeddedFiles identities, reports every requested outcome deterministically, and retains successful results alongside unavailable or corrupt selections. Required extraction publishes only verified payloads; when-present extraction also admits missing metadata, while either policy withholds malformed or mismatched payloads and returns contextual failures. Repair makes selected unattested attachments verifiable without changing canonical identity or existing valid integrity evidence, while corruption prevents publication and every integrity operation preserves established atomic file effects and failure reporting.
